question: Find the simple interest on Rs. 600 at 7% per month in 9 months.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 600

Rate (R) = 7% per month

Time (T) = 9 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculations:**

SI = (600 × 7 × 9) / 100

SI = (37800) / 100

SI = 378

**∴ The simple interest on Rs. 600 at 7% per month in 9 months is Rs. 378.**
